## JWT Decoder Online (Inspect Header, Payload & Expiration)
URL: https://nexvert.online/jwt-decoder/

Debug authentication workflows and inspect JSON Web Tokens (JWT) without risking credential leaks. Decodes the header and payload claims into formatted JSON, converts Unix timestamps into human-readable dates, and flags token expiration status.

### Steps
1. Add your file or input: Choose a supported file, drag it onto the upload area, or type/paste the data this tool works with.
2. Adjust the options: Pick the output format, quality, size or other settings the tool offers. Defaults work well for most files.
3. Process and download: Run the tool and save the result. Processing happens in your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server.

### Questions
Q: Is it safe to paste live production JWTs into this tool?
A: Yes! Unlike cloud-based JWT debuggers that send your token across the web, this decoder runs 100% locally in your browser. Your sensitive auth tokens, user IDs, and permissions never leave your machine.

Q: How does the tool show token expiration?
A: The tool extracts the standard "exp" (expiration) and "iat" (issued at) claims, compares them against your local clock, and displays whether the token is currently active or expired.

Q: Can this tool verify the cryptographic HMAC or RSA signature?
A: You can inspect the signature bytes and algorithm type (HS256, RS256, ES256). For security reasons, signature verification with private keys should always be performed within your secure backend application.

## SHA-256 Hash Generator Online (Web Crypto API)
URL: https://nexvert.online/sha256-generator/

Generate NIST-standard FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 cryptographic hashes for data integrity verification, password hashing benchmarks, and file checksum audits. Powered by crypto.subtle.digest for hardware-accelerated calculation.

### Steps
1. Add your file or input: Choose a supported file, drag it onto the upload area, or type/paste the data this tool works with.
2. Adjust the options: Pick the output format, quality, size or other settings the tool offers. Defaults work well for most files.
3. Process and download: Run the tool and save the result. Processing happens in your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server.

### Questions
Q: How does hardware-accelerated Web Crypto make hashing faster?
A: Modern CPUs include dedicated instruction sets (like Intel SHA Extensions). The browser’s crypto.subtle API taps directly into these native instructions, computing hashes in microseconds.

Q: Can I calculate the SHA-256 hash of a large file before downloading it?
A: Yes! Drop your local file into the hasher to verify its SHA-256 checksum against manufacturer checksums without uploading the file.

Q: Can a SHA-256 hash be reversed to reveal the original text?
A: No. SHA-256 is a one-way cryptographic hash function. It cannot be mathematically reversed to recover the original preimage.

---

## SHA-1 Hash Generator
URL: https://nexvert.online/sha1-generator/

The SHA-1 Hash Generator computes the 160-bit SHA-1 digest of text or of any file you choose, shown as a 40-character hexadecimal string and in Base64. Hashing uses the browser’s native Web Crypto API, so even large files are hashed quickly without uploading them. SHA-1 is still used for Git object IDs and legacy checksums, but it is no longer collision-resistant, so use SHA-256 for security-sensitive purposes.

### Steps
1. Choose text or file input: Type text, or switch to File Input to hash a file.
2. Get the hash: The SHA-1 digest appears instantly in hex and Base64.
3. Copy or compare: Copy the hash or compare it with a published checksum.

### Questions
Q: Is SHA-1 secure?
A: Not for signatures or certificates — practical collision attacks exist. It remains fine for non-security checksums and compatibility with older systems.

Q: Why does my hash differ from another tool?
A: Hashes change with any difference in input, including a trailing newline, different line endings or text encoding. This tool hashes UTF-8 text exactly as typed.

Q: Are files uploaded to be hashed?
A: No. The file is read and hashed locally with Web Crypto.

---

## SHA-512 Hash Generator
URL: https://nexvert.online/sha512-generator/

The SHA-512 Hash Generator produces the 512-bit SHA-2 digest of any text or file, displayed as a 128-character hex string and in Base64. SHA-512 is used for file integrity verification, password-hashing schemes and digital signatures, and is often faster than SHA-256 on 64-bit processors. All hashing runs through the browser’s native Web Crypto API on your device.

### Steps
1. Enter text or pick a file: Type or paste text, or switch to File Input.
2. Read the digest: The SHA-512 hash appears in hex and Base64.
3. Copy it: Copy the value for verification, documentation or code.

### Questions
Q: What is the difference between SHA-256 and SHA-512?
A: Both are SHA-2 hashes. SHA-512 produces a longer 512-bit digest and is often faster on 64-bit CPUs; SHA-256 is more widely used in certificates and blockchains.

Q: Can SHA-512 be reversed?
A: No. Hash functions are one-way; the only way to find the input is to guess it.

Q: Is it safe to hash confidential files here?
A: Yes. Files are hashed on your device and are not transmitted.

---

## MD5 Hash Generator Online (Fast Checksum Calculator)
URL: https://nexvert.online/md5-generator/

Generate RFC 1321 MD5 message digests in lowercase or uppercase hex strings. Commonly used for verifying software package downloads, legacy database deduplication, and generating Gravatar avatar hash keys.

### Steps
1. Add your file or input: Choose a supported file, drag it onto the upload area, or type/paste the data this tool works with.
2. Adjust the options: Pick the output format, quality, size or other settings the tool offers. Defaults work well for most files.
3. Process and download: Run the tool and save the result. Processing happens in your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server.

### Questions
Q: Is MD5 still safe for cryptographic password hashing?
A: No. MD5 is vulnerable to collision attacks and should not be used for security-critical password storage. However, it remains fast and useful for file integrity checks and non-security checksums.

Q: How do I generate a Gravatar email hash with MD5?
A: Trim whitespace from your email address, convert all letters to lowercase, and generate the MD5 hash. The resulting 32-character string is your unique Gravatar identifier.

Q: What output formats are available for the MD5 hash?
A: You can copy the 32-character hash in standard lowercase hexadecimal or uppercase format with one click.

---

## File Checksum Verifier (SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512, MD5)
URL: https://nexvert.online/file-checksum/

The File Checksum Verifier checks that a downloaded file is intact and has not been tampered with. Choose the file, and the tool computes its SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512 and MD5 checksums; paste the checksum published by the software vendor into the verification box to get an instant match or mismatch. Hashing happens entirely in your browser, so large ISO images and installers are never uploaded.

### Steps
1. Select the file: Switch to File Input and choose the downloaded file (or type text).
2. Paste the expected checksum: Copy the SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512 or MD5 value from the download page.
3. Check the result: The tool shows whether the computed hash matches.

### Questions
Q: Which checksum should I compare?
A: Use whichever the publisher lists — SHA-256 is the most common today. The tool calculates all supported algorithms so you can match any of them.

Q: What does a mismatch mean?
A: The file differs from the original: the download may be incomplete or corrupted, or it is not the file the publisher released. Download it again from the official source.

Q: Is uppercase vs lowercase important?
A: No. Hex checksums are compared case-insensitively.

## CSS Minifier – Compress CSS Online
URL: https://nexvert.online/css-minifier/

The CSS Minifier shrinks stylesheets for production by removing comments, indentation, line breaks and unnecessary spaces around braces, colons and semicolons. Smaller CSS downloads faster and blocks rendering for less time, which helps Core Web Vitals. The rules themselves are not changed, so the page renders identically.

### Steps
1. Paste your CSS: Paste the stylesheet you want to compress.
2. Minify: The minified CSS appears instantly.
3. Copy to production: Copy the result into your .min.css file or inline <style> block.

### Questions
Q: How much smaller will my CSS be?
A: Usually 15–30% before gzip, depending on how many comments and how much indentation the original has.

Q: Is minified CSS safe to use?
A: Yes. Only characters that browsers ignore are removed.

Q: Does it remove unused CSS?
A: No. Removing unused selectors requires analysing your HTML; this tool only removes whitespace and comments.

## UUID / GUID Generator Online (v4 Cryptographically Secure)
URL: https://nexvert.online/uuid-generator/

Create universally unique identifiers (UUIDs / GUIDs) for database primary keys, API transaction tracking, and distributed systems. Uses crypto.getRandomValues() for certified cryptographic randomness.

### Steps
1. Add your file or input: Choose a supported file, drag it onto the upload area, or type/paste the data this tool works with.
2. Adjust the options: Pick the output format, quality, size or other settings the tool offers. Defaults work well for most files.
3. Process and download: Run the tool and save the result. Processing happens in your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server.

### Questions
Q: How are Version 4 UUIDs generated securely?
A: UUID v4 utilizes 122 bits of cryptographically strong pseudo-random entropy generated by your operating system’s CSPRNG via crypto.getRandomValues(), with version and variant bits set in accordance with RFC 4122.

Q: What is the probability of a UUID v4 collision?
A: Virtually zero. To have a 50% chance of a single collision, you would need to generate over 2.71 quintillion UUIDs, making it practically impossible in real-world systems.

Q: Can I generate bulk batches of UUIDs at once?
A: Yes! You can generate up to 1,000 UUIDs in a single click with options for uppercase formatting, hyphen removal, or JSON array wrapping.

## Strong Password Generator Online (Cryptographically Random)
URL: https://nexvert.online/password-generator/

Protect your digital accounts against brute-force and dictionary attacks. Generates high-entropy passwords with custom length, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special symbols using crypto.getRandomValues().

### Steps
1. Add your file or input: Choose a supported file, drag it onto the upload area, or type/paste the data this tool works with.
2. Adjust the options: Pick the output format, quality, size or other settings the tool offers. Defaults work well for most files.
3. Process and download: Run the tool and save the result. Processing happens in your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server.

### Questions
Q: Why is crypto.getRandomValues() safer than Math.random() for passwords?
A: Math.random() is pseudo-random and predictable. The Web Crypto API uses cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generators (CSPRNG) seeded by physical hardware entropy from your device OS.

Q: Are generated passwords saved or sent over the internet?
A: Never. Passwords are generated in your local device memory and exist only on your screen until you copy them. We have zero servers logging generated credentials.

Q: What password length is considered unbreakable today?
A: A password with 16 or more mixed characters (letters, numbers, symbols) provides over 95 bits of entropy, which would take quantum supercomputers trillions of years to brute force.

## Unix Timestamp Converter
URL: https://nexvert.online/timestamp-converter/

The Unix Timestamp Converter translates epoch time — the number of seconds (or milliseconds) since 1 January 1970 UTC — into readable dates, and back. Enter a timestamp to see it as ISO 8601, UTC and local time in the time zone you choose, or set the current time with one click. Developers use it to read log files, debug API responses and check token expiry times.

### Steps
1. Enter a timestamp or date: Type an epoch value in seconds or milliseconds, or use Set Current Time.
2. Pick a time zone: Choose the zone to display the local time in.
3. Copy the format you need: Copy the ISO, UTC, local or epoch value.

### Questions
Q: Seconds or milliseconds?
A: A 10-digit value is seconds and a 13-digit value is milliseconds. JavaScript Date uses milliseconds; most Unix tools and APIs use seconds.

Q: What is timestamp 0?
A: 1 January 1970 at 00:00:00 UTC, the Unix epoch.

Q: What is the year 2038 problem?
A: Systems that store timestamps as signed 32-bit integers overflow on 19 January 2038. JavaScript and this tool use 64-bit numbers, so they are not affected.

## Cron Expression Parser – Explain Cron in Plain English
URL: https://nexvert.online/cron-parser/

The Cron Expression Parser explains what a cron schedule means in plain English — for example "*/15 * * * *" becomes "Every 15 minutes". Paste an expression from a crontab, Kubernetes CronJob, GitHub Actions workflow or cloud scheduler to confirm it runs when you expect, or start from presets such as every hour, daily at midnight, weekdays at 9 AM or weekly on Sunday.

### Steps
1. Enter a cron expression: Type the five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week.
2. Read the explanation: The schedule is described in plain English as you type.
3. Use a preset: Click a preset to start from a common schedule and adjust it.

### Questions
Q: What do the five cron fields mean?
A: In order: minute (0–59), hour (0–23), day of month (1–31), month (1–12) and day of week (0–6, Sunday = 0).

Q: What does */15 mean?
A: "Every 15 units" of that field — in the minute field it runs at :00, :15, :30 and :45.

Q: Which time zone does cron use?
A: The server or scheduler’s time zone, usually UTC in cloud services. Check your platform’s settings.

## Color Palette Extractor – Get Colours from an Image
URL: https://nexvert.online/color-palette-extractor/

Copy individual HEX codes or the whole palette as CSS custom properties to use in a website theme, brand guide or design system. The image is analysed in your browser and never uploaded.

2. Review the palette: Dominant colours appear with HEX codes and percentages.
3. Export: Copy single HEX values or all colours as CSS variables.

### Questions
Q: How are the colours chosen?
A: Pixels are grouped by similarity with k-means clustering; each group’s average colour becomes a palette entry, ordered by how much of the image it covers.

Q: Why does the palette change slightly each run?
A: K-means starts from sampled points, so near-identical shades can merge differently. The dominant colours stay the same.

Q: Can I use it for brand colours from a logo?
A: Yes. Logos with flat colours give very accurate results.

### Questions
Q: What contrast ratio do I need?
A: WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (24 px, or 18.66 px bold). AAA requires 7:1 and 4.5:1.

Q: Does it support transparent colours?
A: Enter the final visible colour; transparency must be blended with the background first.

## Free QR Code Reader & Scanner – Live Camera & Image File Upload
URL: https://nexvert.online/qr-reader/

The Free QR Code Reader & Scanner provides high-speed 2D matrix barcode decoding through your browser using hardware-accelerated computer vision algorithms. Supporting both real-time webcam video stream scanning and static file uploads (PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, SVG), the scanner decodes Quick Response matrices to extract embedded text payloads, website URLs, Wi-Fi network configurations, vCard contact information, cryptocurrency wallet addresses, and multi-factor authentication TOTP setup secrets. This utility is invaluable when you receive a digital flyer or meeting invite containing a QR code on your laptop screen and cannot easily scan it with your smartphone, or when you need to inspect an unknown QR code safely without automatically opening a malicious URL in a mobile browser. The decoder runs strictly in client memory, meaning no scanned URLs or credentials leave your computer. One physical constraint to consider is that heavily damaged, smudged, or low-resolution camera feeds where alignment position patterns (the three square finder corners) are occluded will fail mathematical Reed-Solomon error correction and cannot be recovered.

### Steps
1. Select Input Method: Choose between activating your device webcam for live video matrix recognition or uploading an image file containing a target QR code from your storage.
2. Locate & Decode Matrix: Align the QR code within the bounding viewfinder reticle or allow the canvas parser to automatically detect finder patterns in the uploaded graphic.
3. Inspect Payload & Copy Data: Review the decoded raw string or parsed payload structure and click to copy data to your clipboard or open verified URLs safely in a new browser tab.

### Questions
Q: Does this scanner automatically visit links found in QR codes?
A: No. To protect you against phishing and drive-by malware attacks, the reader displays the full plain-text URL and domain for your manual verification before you choose to open it, preventing accidental navigation to unverified external destinations.

Q: Can I scan QR codes displayed on other open browser windows or desktop apps?
A: Yes. You can take a quick screenshot using your operating system shortcut (e.g., Win+Shift+S or Cmd+Shift+4) and paste or upload the screenshot image directly into the scanner to decode on-screen QR codes in seconds.

Q: How does the scanner handle inverted or colored custom QR codes?
A: The decoding pipeline applies dynamic thresholding and adaptive contrast normalization to successfully decode white-on-black, brand-tinted, and custom-styled QR codes that standard laser scanners or basic camera apps often reject.

## Free Barcode Generator – Create CODE128, EAN-13, UPC & CODE39
URL: https://nexvert.online/barcode-generator/

The Free Barcode Generator allows logistics coordinators, warehouse managers, retail merchants, and product manufacturers to create standard 1D linear barcodes directly within their browser without dedicated label hardware. Supporting all major international symbologies—including CODE128 (high-density alphanumeric), EAN-13 (international retail packaging), UPC-A (North American retail goods), CODE39 (automotive and defense logistics), and ITF-14 (corrugated shipping cartons)—this tool computes exact bar-and-space widths alongside mandatory checksum parity digits. Everyday use cases include creating product SKU labels for retail store shelves, generating book ISBN barcodes, creating asset tags for office IT equipment, and formatting shipping manifest labels. Output graphics can be exported as scalable vector SVG graphics for crisp professional printing or high-DPI raster PNGs. Users should note that commercial retail barcodes (such as official EAN-13 and UPC-A numbers intended for general consumer sale) must be formally licensed through GS1 to be officially recognized in global point-of-sale checkout databases worldwide. By generating standards-compliant vector symbologies directly in your browser, you eliminate expensive third-party barcode software and avoid proprietary subscription fees.

### Steps
1. Choose Barcode Symbology: Select your required standard from the symbology menu (such as CODE128 for general inventory, EAN-13 for international retail, or UPC-A for North American consumer products).
2. Enter Barcode Value & Label Text: Type your numerical SKU or alphanumeric asset identifier and toggle whether to display human-readable text digits beneath the vertical bar pattern.
3. Download Scalable Vector Barcode: Preview bar widths, verify checksum parity calculations, and export your production-ready barcode in lossless SVG or high-resolution PNG format ready for label printers.

### Questions
Q: What is the best barcode format for general warehouse and internal asset tracking?
A: CODE128 is the industry standard for internal inventory because it supports all 128 ASCII characters (including numbers, uppercase letters, and lowercase letters) with high data density, making it versatile for internal logistics.

Q: Why does the generator warn that my EAN-13 barcode has an invalid checksum?
A: EAN-13 barcodes require exactly 12 data digits followed by a 13th modulo-10 mathematical check digit. Our tool can automatically compute and append the correct checksum digit for you based on the preceding numbers to ensure scanner readability.

Q: Will vector SVG barcodes scan reliably when printed at small physical sizes?
A: Yes. SVG exports render mathematical vector geometry that scales to any printer DPI without pixelation or antialiasing blur that could confuse laser barcode scanners during physical warehouse inventory audits.

The Free Wi-Fi QR Code Generator enables cafe owners, event organizers, Airbnb hosts, and office administrators to author standardized wireless network connection QR codes. Modern iOS and Android operating systems feature native camera recognition for standardized Wi-Fi URI strings (WIFI:S:MyNetwork;T:WPA;P:MyPassword;;). When a guest aims their smartphone camera at the generated QR code, their device prompts an immediate "Join Network" button that handles authentication automatically, eliminating frustrating typos in long alphanumeric security keys. 3. Print or Download QR Asset: Test the live screen QR code with your smartphone camera to verify instant connectivity, then print or download high-resolution PNG cards for framing.

### Questions
Q: Is my home or corporate Wi-Fi password sent to any server when generating the code?
A: No. The Wi-Fi QR code is rendered entirely inside your local browser memory using client-side JavaScript. Your sensitive network credentials never cross the internet or reach remote log files, ensuring complete wireless confidentiality.

Q: Does this Wi-Fi QR code work on both Apple iPhones and Android smartphones?
A: Yes. All iPhones running iOS 11 or newer and Android devices running Android 9 or newer natively recognize standard Wi-Fi QR codes directly via their default camera applications without requiring any third-party scanner apps.

Q: Can I create a QR code for a hidden Wi-Fi network that does not broadcast its SSID?
A: Yes. Simply check the "Hidden Network" checkbox, and the generator embeds the special H:true flag inside the Wi-Fi configuration string so devices can discover and join the hidden SSID automatically.

Q: Can I see exactly how many duplicate lines were identified and removed?

## Sort Lines Online – Alphabetical, Numerical & Length Sorting
URL: https://nexvert.online/sort-lines/

The Sort Lines tool organizes disorganized text lists, dictionaries, code imports, glossary entries, and numerical data into structured, predictable sequences with zero latency. Designed for writers, coders, data scientists, and administrative professionals, this utility provides multiple sorting algorithms: Natural Alphabetical (A to Z and Z to A), Natural Numeric (properly ordering 1, 2, 10 rather than 1, 10, 2), Line Length (shortest to longest and vice versa), and Random Shuffle. You can also toggle case sensitivity, ignore leading whitespace, and strip duplicate entries during the sorting operation. Everyday applications include alphabetizing bibliography citations, organizing CSS properties or JavaScript import statements in source code, ranking numerical scores, and shuffling test questions. All sorting logic runs locally on your device CPU with zero delay. Keep in mind that sorting lists with irregular indentation may produce unexpected ordering unless the "Ignore Leading Whitespace" option is enabled before initiating sorting. From cleaning up keyword sets to sequencing scientific terminology, this browser utility provides predictable, deterministic sorting across diverse text structures.

### Steps
1. Input Text to Sort: Paste your unordered lines into the text area or drop a UTF-8 text document into the workspace to initialize the line parser and character counter.
2. Select Sorting Algorithm: Choose your preferred order: Alphabetical (A-Z), Reverse Alphabetical (Z-A), Natural Numeric, Line Length, or Random Shuffle depending on your needs.
3. Copy or Save Sorted Text: Review the live reordered text output and copy the sorted list directly to your clipboard or download it as an organized plain text file to disk.

### Questions
Q: How does natural numerical sorting differ from standard alphabetical sorting?
A: Standard alphabetical sorting puts "100" before "2" because it evaluates characters sequentially from left to right. Natural numerical sorting understands multi-digit quantities, correctly sequencing 2 before 100 as expected in human counting.

Q: Can I sort lines by character length rather than alphabetical letters?
A: Yes. Selecting the "Sort by Length" mode arranges lines from shortest to longest (or longest to shortest), which is popular for authoring poetry, formatting social media bios, and balancing visual typography hierarchies.

Q: Does the sorting algorithm support international accented characters and non-Latin scripts?
A: Yes. The sorter utilizes the standard Unicode Collation Algorithm (Intl.Collator), ensuring accurate linguistic alphabetical sorting for Spanish, French, German, Cyrillic, and Asian alphabets based on locale rules.

URL: https://nexvert.online/find-and-replace/

The Find and Replace Text tool gives developers, copy editors, data cleaners, and students a dependable, client-side utility for performing bulk text transformations across large documents without risking information exposure. The real-time counter displays exactly how many replacements were made and highlights matches in context before you commit. Remember that when using regular expressions, unescaped special characters (such as dots, brackets, and parentheses) will be evaluated as regex operators rather than literal characters. Technical writers and programmers can execute sweeping text substitutions across extensive documents without needing complex command-line scripting tools.

A: Yes. Check the "Use Regular Expression" toggle to leverage full JavaScript regex syntax, including capture groups ($1, $2), lookaheads, word boundaries, and character classes for powerful multi-pattern substitutions.

Q: Can I replace text with line breaks or tab indents?
A: Yes. When using regex mode, you can use escape sequences such as \n for newline breaks and \t for horizontal tabs in both search and replacement fields to clean formatted code or prose structures.

Q: What happens if I leave the Replace field completely blank?
A: Leaving the Replace field blank will delete every matched instance of the target term from your text, making it ideal for stripping unwanted words, tracking tags, or specific punctuation marks across documents.

## Reverse Text Online – Backwards Text, Word & Line Inverter
URL: https://nexvert.online/reverse-text/

The Reverse Text tool provides multiple directional inversion transformations for plain text, strings, and multi-line documents without third-party tracking. Built for cryptogram puzzle creators, software engineers testing string reversal algorithms, social media enthusiasts creating mirror text, and data analysts checking palindrome symmetry, this tool offers four distinct inversion modes: Reverse Characters (flips every letter backwards so "hello" becomes "olleh"), Reverse Words (inverts word positions while preserving individual word letter spelling), Reverse Lines (flips multi-line documents upside down so the last line becomes the first), and Reverse Words and Characters. Utilizing Unicode-aware grapheme splitting, the tool properly handles complex emojis and accent marks without corrupting surrogate pairs. All transformations execute locally in browser memory. Keep in mind that right-to-left linguistic scripts (such as Arabic or Hebrew) will have their visual bidirectional rendering inverted by character reversal, which may alter grammatical display significantly. Puzzle designers, linguistic researchers, and social media managers can explore creative typography and string inversion patterns with immediate visual feedback.

### Steps
1. Input Text to Invert: Paste your sentence, word, or multi-line document into the source text area to begin live directional inversion processing.

3. Copy Inverted Text: Review the live reversed text in the output box and click Copy to Clipboard for immediate use in your documents, social posts, or code tests.

### Questions
Q: Does the character reverser break emojis or accented characters?
A: No. Our algorithm splits strings using Unicode grapheme cluster segmentation, ensuring compound emojis (like family groups or skin tone modifiers) remain intact rather than splitting into broken question mark symbols or separated codepoints.

Q: How do I reverse an entire document so the last paragraph appears first?
A: Select the "Reverse Lines" mode. This leaves the internal spelling and words of each line intact while flipping the vertical line order upside down, which is ideal for reviewing log files in reverse chronological order.

Q: Can this tool be used to verify if a phrase is a palindrome?
A: Yes. Reversing characters allows you to visually compare whether a phrase reads identically forward and backwards (ignoring punctuation, spaces, and case differences) to verify palindrome symmetry.

## Roman Numeral Converter
URL: https://nexvert.online/roman-numeral-converter/

The Roman Numeral Converter translates between Arabic numbers and Roman numerals in both directions — for example 2024 is MMXXIV. It follows the standard subtractive rules (IV for 4, IX for 9, XL for 40, CM for 900) and supports the classic range of 1 to 3999. Useful for dates on monuments and film credits, book chapters, clock faces, outlines and tattoos.

### Steps
1. Choose a direction: Number → Roman numeral or Roman numeral → number.
2. Enter the value: Type a number from 1 to 3999 or a Roman numeral.
3. Copy the result: Copy the converted value.

### Questions
Q: Why only up to 3999?
A: Standard Roman numerals have no symbol above M (1000), and M can repeat at most three times, so 3999 (MMMCMXCIX) is the largest regular value.

Q: How is 2026 written?
A: MMXXVI — MM (2000) + XX (20) + VI (6).

Q: Is there a Roman numeral for zero?
A: No. The Roman system had no zero.

URL: https://nexvert.online/date-calculator/

The Date Calculator has two modes. Date Difference counts the exact number of days (and weeks, months and years) between two dates — for deadlines, notice periods, project durations or countdowns. Add / Subtract Days finds the date a given number of days before or after a start date, such as 90 days from today. Leap years and month lengths are handled automatically.

### Steps
1. Choose a mode: Date Difference or Add / Subtract Days.
2. Enter the dates or days: Pick the start and end dates, or a start date and a number of days.
3. Read and copy: See the result and copy it.

### Questions
Q: Does it include the end date?
A: The difference counts the days between the dates (1 January to 31 December is 365 days). Add one if you need to count both start and end days.

Q: How many days are in 2024?
A: 366, because 2024 is a leap year.

Q: Can it count business days only?
A: It counts calendar days. Weekends and holidays are included.

## BMI Calculator
URL: https://nexvert.online/bmi-calculator/

The BMI Calculator computes Body Mass Index from height and weight — weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared — in metric or imperial units, and shows the World Health Organization category: underweight (below 18.5), healthy (18.5–24.9), overweight (25–29.9) or obese (30 and above). For example, 70 kg at 175 cm gives a BMI of 22.9. BMI is a quick screening measure, not a diagnosis.

### Steps
1. Choose units: Metric (kg, cm) or imperial (lb, ft/in).
2. Enter height and weight: Type your measurements.
3. See your BMI: Read the BMI value and its WHO category.

### Questions
Q: What is a healthy BMI?
A: 18.5 to 24.9 for adults, according to the WHO.

Q: Is BMI accurate for athletes?
A: Not always. BMI does not distinguish muscle from fat, so muscular people may be classed as overweight.

Q: Does BMI apply to children?
A: Children and teens use age- and sex-specific BMI percentiles, so adult categories do not apply.

## Loan EMI Calculator
URL: https://nexvert.online/loan-calculator/

The Loan EMI Calculator shows the fixed monthly payment (EMI) for a home, car or personal loan using the standard amortisation formula, together with the total interest and total amount you will repay. Enter the loan amount, annual interest rate and term in years — for example 250,000 at 7.5% over 15 years gives an EMI of about 2,318 per month. Change any value to compare offers instantly.

### Steps
1. Enter the loan amount: Type the principal you plan to borrow.
2. Set rate and term: Enter the annual interest rate and the number of years.
3. Compare the results: Read the monthly EMI, total interest and total payable.

### Questions
Q: How is EMI calculated?
A: EMI = P × r × (1 + r)^n ÷ ((1 + r)^n − 1), where P is the principal, r the monthly interest rate and n the number of monthly payments.

Q: Does a longer term reduce the total cost?
A: No. A longer term lowers the monthly EMI but increases the total interest paid.

Q: Are fees and insurance included?
A: No. The calculation covers principal and interest only; add lender fees separately.

## Tip Calculator & Bill Splitter
URL: https://nexvert.online/tip-calculator/

The Tip Calculator calculates the tip and total for a restaurant bill and splits it evenly between everyone at the table. Enter the bill amount and number of people, then choose 10%, 15%, 18%, 20% or 25% — or type a custom percentage. You see the tip amount, the total and what each person pays, ready to copy into a group chat.

### Steps
1. Enter the bill: Type the bill amount before tip.
2. Choose tip and people: Select a tip percentage and the number of people.
3. Split it: See the tip, total and per-person amount, and copy the split.

### Questions
Q: How much should I tip?
A: Customs vary: in the US 15–20% is standard for table service; in many other countries a smaller tip or rounding up is usual.

Q: Should the tip be on the amount before tax?
A: Traditionally yes — tip on the pre-tax subtotal — though many people tip on the total for simplicity.

Q: How is the per-person amount rounded?
A: It is shown to two decimal places; round up if you are paying in cash.

## Discount Calculator – Sale Price & Savings
URL: https://nexvert.online/discount-calculator/

The Discount Calculator shows the final price after a percentage discount and how much you save — for example 25% off 120 is 90. It also handles stacked discounts: enter an additional coupon percentage and it is applied to the already-reduced price, which is how most shops calculate "an extra 10% off sale items". Useful for comparing deals and checking prices at checkout.

### Steps
1. Enter the original price: Type the price before any discount.
2. Add the discounts: Enter the main discount and any extra coupon percentage.
3. See the final price: Read the sale price and total savings, and copy them.

### Questions
Q: Is 20% + 10% the same as 30% off?
A: No. Stacked discounts multiply: 20% then 10% off is 28% in total, because the second discount applies to the reduced price.

Q: How do I calculate a discount percentage?
A: Subtract the sale price from the original price, divide by the original price and multiply by 100.

Q: Does it include sales tax?
A: No. Add tax separately, for example with the GST / VAT calculator.

## Aspect Ratio Calculator Online (16:9, 4:3, 21:9 & Custom)
URL: https://nexvert.online/aspect-ratio-calculator/

Size video canvases and graphic assets accurately. Select industry-standard aspect ratios (16:9 widescreen, 4:3 SD, 9:16 mobile, 21:9 ultrawide) or calculate custom proportions from existing pixel dimensions.

### Steps
1. Add your file or input: Choose a supported file, drag it onto the upload area, or type/paste the data this tool works with.
2. Adjust the options: Pick the output format, quality, size or other settings the tool offers. Defaults work well for most files.
3. Process and download: Run the tool and save the result. Processing happens in your browser, so nothing is uploaded to a server.

### Questions
Q: How do you find the simplified aspect ratio of any resolution?
A: The calculator finds the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) using Euclid’s algorithm for both width and height (e.g. 1920x1080 divided by 120 yields exactly 16:9).

Q: What is the standard aspect ratio for YouTube and modern monitors?
A: 16:9 is the universal standard for YouTube, high-definition television, and desktop monitors, with common resolutions of 1920x1080 (1080p) and 3840x2160 (4K).

Q: Can I scale an image to a specific width and calculate the exact height?
A: Yes! Enter your desired width and lock the ratio; the matching height is calculated instantly.

## GST / VAT Calculator
URL: https://nexvert.online/gst-calculator/

The GST Calculator adds tax to a price or extracts tax from a price that already includes it. In exclusive mode, 18% GST on 5,000 is 900, for a total of 5,900. In inclusive mode, the tool works backwards from the total to show the net amount and the tax inside it. Rates of 5%, 12%, 18% (standard) and 28% are available, matching India’s GST slabs, and the same maths applies to VAT and sales tax anywhere.

### Steps
1. Enter the amount: Type the net or gross amount.
2. Choose exclusive or inclusive: Add GST to the amount, or extract GST already included in it.
3. Select the rate: Pick 5%, 12%, 18% or 28% and copy the breakdown.

### Questions
Q: How do I remove GST from a price?
A: Choose Inclusive. The net price is the total ÷ (1 + rate); for 18% that is total ÷ 1.18.

Q: How is GST split into CGST and SGST?
A: For sales within one Indian state, the GST amount is split equally: at 18%, 9% CGST and 9% SGST.

Q: Can I use it for VAT?
A: Yes. The calculation is identical; choose the rate that matches your VAT rate if it is listed.

## Favicon Generator – Create Favicon PNGs from an Image
URL: https://nexvert.online/favicon-generator/

The Favicon Generator converts a square logo or image into the set of icons websites need: favicon PNGs at 16×16, 32×32 and 48×48, a 180×180 Apple touch icon, 192×192 and 512×512 Android Chrome icons, and a site.webmanifest file, packaged together in one ZIP with the HTML tags to paste into your page head. Start from a square image of at least 512×512 px for sharp results. Everything is generated in your browser.

### Steps
1. Upload your logo: Choose a square PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG, ideally 512×512 px or larger.
2. Generate the pack: All icon sizes and the web manifest are created instantly.
3. Download and install: Download the ZIP, upload the files to your site root and paste the HTML tags into <head>.

### Questions
Q: What size should my favicon image be?
A: Start with a square image of at least 512×512 px. The tool scales it down to every required size.

Q: Why does Google show a different icon for my site?
A: Google needs a favicon that is a multiple of 48 px and crawlable. After updating, Google can take days or weeks to refresh it in results.

Q: Do I still need favicon.ico?
A: Modern browsers use the PNG icons. An .ico file is only needed for very old browsers or tools that request /favicon.ico directly.

## Open Graph Image Generator (1200×630)
URL: https://nexvert.online/og-image-generator/

The OG Image Generator creates the preview image that appears when your page is shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Slack or WhatsApp. Enter a title, subtitle, brand name and tag, pick one of five colour themes, and download a high-resolution 1200×630 PNG — the size recommended for og:image. Add it to your page with an og:image meta tag.

### Steps
1. Write the text: Enter the title, subtitle, brand and tag.
2. Pick a theme: Choose Midnight, Slate, Emerald, Amber or Indigo.
3. Download the PNG: Save the 1200×630 image and reference it in your og:image tag.

### Questions
Q: What size should an Open Graph image be?
A: 1200×630 pixels (a 1.91:1 ratio) works for Facebook, LinkedIn, X and most messaging apps.

Q: How do I add it to my website?
A: Upload the PNG and add <meta property="og:image" content="https://your-site.com/og-image.png"> to the page head.

Q: Why does Facebook still show the old image?
A: Social networks cache previews. Use Facebook’s Sharing Debugger to force a refresh.

## Random Name Picker & Decision Maker
URL: https://nexvert.online/random-picker/

The Random Picker chooses one item at random from a list you enter — names for a giveaway, who presents first, what to eat tonight. Enter one option per line and press Pick a Winner. Turn on "Remove picked item" to draw several winners in turn without repeats. The pick uses the browser’s cryptographically secure random generator, so every option has an equal chance.

### Steps
1. Enter your options: Type or paste one name or choice per line.
2. Pick a winner: Press Pick a Winner to choose at random.
3. Draw again: Enable Remove picked item to draw more winners without repeats.

### Questions
Q: Is the pick truly random?
A: It uses crypto.getRandomValues(), a cryptographically secure source, so each option has the same probability.

Q: Can I use it for giveaways?
A: Yes. Paste the entrant list and, for multiple winners, enable removal so nobody is picked twice.

Q: Is my list saved?
A: No. It stays in your browser tab only.

Results come from a cryptographically secure random generator, so the dice are fair.

### Steps
1. Choose the die: Pick d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 or d100.
2. Set count and modifier: Enter how many dice to roll and any bonus or penalty.
3. Roll: See every die, the total, and copy the sum.

### Questions
Q: Are the rolls fair?
A: Yes. Each roll uses crypto.getRandomValues() with rejection sampling so every face is equally likely.

Q: What does 2d6+3 mean?
A: Roll two six-sided dice and add 3 to the total.

Q: Can I roll a d100?
A: Yes. Choose d100 for percentile rolls from 1 to 100.

## Flip a Coin Online – Heads or Tails
URL: https://nexvert.online/coin-flip/

Coin Flip tosses a virtual coin and lands on heads or tails with an exactly 50/50 chance — handy for settling decisions, choosing who goes first, or probability lessons. Each flip uses the browser’s cryptographically secure random generator rather than a predictable formula, so results cannot be anticipated.

### Steps
1. Press Flip Coin: The coin spins and lands.
2. Read the result: See heads or tails.
3. Flip again: Flip as many times as you like.

### Questions
Q: Is the virtual coin fair?
A: Yes. Each flip has an exactly equal chance of heads and tails from a cryptographically secure random source.

Q: Does the previous result affect the next flip?
A: No. Every flip is independent, just like a real coin.

Q: Can I use it for important decisions?
A: It is as fair as a real coin toss — the rest is up to you.

## Random Number Generator
URL: https://nexvert.online/random-number/

The Random Number Generator produces random integers between a minimum and maximum you choose — for lotteries, raffles, sampling, games and testing. Generate several numbers at once, sort them ascending or descending, and choose "unique numbers only" to prevent duplicates, for example 6 unique numbers from 1 to 49. Numbers come from crypto.getRandomValues(), a cryptographically secure source.

### Steps
1. Set the range: Enter the minimum and maximum values.
2. Choose count and options: Pick how many numbers, sorting, and whether they must be unique.
3. Generate: Press Generate Numbers and copy the results.

### Questions
Q: Are the numbers truly random?
A: They come from the browser’s cryptographically secure generator, suitable for fair draws and security-sensitive uses.

Q: Are the minimum and maximum included?
A: Yes. Both ends of the range can be drawn.

Q: How do I pick lottery numbers?
A: Set the range (for example 1–49), the count (6) and enable unique numbers only.
